headline: Homeplus Shortens Supplier Settlement Cycle: "Up to 3 Payments Per Month"
summary: Homeplus will pay suppliers for products at intervals of at least 10 days and at most 30 days, to restore supplier trust. The shorter cycle applies only to some fresh food suppliers.
why: Homeplus is a South Korean retail chain, and supplier payment terms affect its working capital and relationships with vendors.
